title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Revelation 3: the words to Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea, the book of life, the open door, and the voice at the door.

questions.text: What does he say about the assembly in Sardis?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:1 says they have a reputation of being alive, but they are dead.

answers.text: It has a reputation of being alive, but it is dead
It is rich and has need of nothing
It is poor but is truly rich
It has left behind its first love

questions.text: How will he come to Sardis if they will not watch?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:3 says that if they will not watch, he will come as a thief, and they will not know what hour he will come upon them.

answers.text: With the clouds
As a thief
With a sharp sword
With seven lamps of fire

questions.text: What does the text say about the few names in Sardis?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:4 says they have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments, and they will walk with him in white.

answers.text: They had already left the city
They held the teaching of Balaam
They did not defile their garments
They were thrown into prison

questions.text: What does he promise he will in no way do to the name of him who overcomes?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:5 says he will in no way blot his name out of the book of life.

answers.text: Write it on a white stone
Exchange it for a new name
Hide it from his Father
Blot it out of the book of life

questions.text: What does the one who speaks to Philadelphia say he holds?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:7 says he who is holy and true has the key of David, who opens and no one can shut, and shuts and no one opens.

answers.text: The key of David
The keys of Death and Hades
A rod of iron
A golden sash

questions.text: What has he set before the assembly in Philadelphia?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:8 says he has set before them an open door, which no one can shut.

answers.text: A crown of gold for its head
A sea of glass like crystal
An open door, which no one can shut
A pillar of fire by night

questions.text: What will he make him who overcomes, in the words to Philadelphia?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:12 says he will make him a pillar in the temple of his God, and he will go out from there no more.

answers.text: A king over the nations
A pillar in the temple of his God
An angel of the assemblies
A witness to the Gentiles

questions.text: Why will he vomit the assembly in Laodicea out of his mouth?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:16 says it is because they are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold.

answers.text: Because they tolerate the woman Jezebel
Because they left their first love
Because they deny his name
Because they are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold

questions.text: Which three things does he counsel Laodicea to buy from him?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:18 counsels them to buy gold refined by fire, white garments to clothe themselves, and eye salve to anoint their eyes.

answers.text: Gold refined by fire, white garments, and eye salve
Bread, wine, and oil for their tables
Incense, harps, and golden bowls
Gold, frankincense, and sweet myrrh

questions.text: What does he say he is doing at the door?
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:20 says, "Behold, I stand at the door and knock," and that he will come in to anyone who hears his voice and opens.

answers.text: Shutting it forever
Guarding it with a sword
Standing there and knocking
Writing a new name on it
